definitions.explanation: A licensed professional who cuts, styles, colors, and treats hair. In Japan, beauticians work at {美容室|びようしつ} (beauty salons) and require a national license.

examples.japanese: {美容師|びようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my hair cut by a hairdresser.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美容師|びようし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: My older sister has a beautician's license.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美容師|びようし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧か{月|げつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{埋|う}まっている→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Popular hairstylists can be booked up months in advance.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {美容師|びようし} and ⟦{理容師|りようし}→理容師：24118_riyoushi⟧ (barber) are legally distinct professions with separate licenses. {美容師|びようし} work at ⟦{美容室|びようしつ}→美容室：20238_biyoushitsu⟧/⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧ and traditionally serve women, while ⟦{理容師|りようし}→理容師：24118_riyoushi⟧ work at ⟦{理容室|りようしつ}→理容室：18078_riyoushitsu⟧/⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧ and traditionally serve men, though these gender distinctions have become less rigid.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美容師|びようし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧ (beautician's license)
- {美容師|びようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a beautician)
- ⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美容師|びようし} (one's regular hairdresser)
